page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2.7xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 architecture, utilizing the Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz. The system is equipped with 128.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of memory per core. It does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, relying instead on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core performance. Single-core metrics, such as stress-ng and Geekbench single-core scores, fall into the bottom 25%, reflecting the older generation Intel Xeon processor. However, multi-core performance scales effectively, achieving average tier results in stress-ng multi-core, Passmark CPU, and Geekbench multi-core benchmarks. Memory bandwidth tests show average read and write speeds, though the Passmark memory score is positioned in the lower quartile.

Given the dedicated CPU allocation and balanced resource distribution, this instance is suited for multi-threaded workloads that can leverage all 32 cores, such as static web serving, database operations, and medium-scale LLM inference. However, it is less optimal for single-threaded tasks or applications requiring high-speed local NVMe storage. The hardware profile offers a stable, dedicated resource pool for enterprise applications where predictable multi-core execution is prioritized over peak single-core speed.
